# Armor (`magic-items:armor`)
**Category:** [Armor](../equipment-categories/armor.md) | **Rarity:** Rare (+1), Very Rare (+2), or Legendary (+3) | **Attunement:** No
**Variants:** [Armor +1](../magic-items/armor-1.md), [Armor +2](../magic-items/armor-2.md), [Armor +3](../magic-items/armor-3.md)

Armor (Any Light, Medium, or Heavy)

You have a bonus to Armor Class while wearing this armor. The bonus is determined by its rarity.
